I am a make-up artist and hair stylist with a deep passion for the world of beauty and creativity.
I believe that make-up is an art that goes beyond the simple application of products: it is a way to express your personality, celebrate your uniqueness, and boost your self-confidence.
My approach is always personalized: I listen carefully to your needs and desires to create a look that not only enhances you, but makes you feel authentically yourself.
Enhancing your beauty with professionalism and creativity.
I have perfected my skills by attending courses and workshops with the best professionals in the industry, acquiring cutting-edge techniques in bridal, ceremonial, photographic, and cinematic makeup.
My continuous training is a priority, to always stay updated on the latest trends and offer innovative, high-quality services.
Contact me today for a personalized consultation and discover how I can help you achieve the look of your dreams.

I am a Make-up Artist specialized in beauty & bridal makeup, with a deep passion for the art of make-up that constantly drives me to seek out the latest trends and techniques.

Are you looking for a make-up and hair styling service that makes you feel unique and radiant?
With my experience and attention to detail, I turn your desires into reality, enhancing your natural beauty and creating a look that fully reflects you.
Whether it's for your wedding day, a special event, or a photoshoot, I guarantee a personalized experience and an impeccable result.
No stress, just beauty and privacy.
My goal is to make you feel beautiful, confident, and at ease, on every occasion.
I use only professional products from the best brands to ensure long-lasting and flawless results, respecting your skin.
Your peace of mind is my priority. I am always punctual and organize every detail for a seamless service.
Every face is unique. Together we will create the perfect look that enhances your natural beauty and fits your style.
From the first consultation to the day of the event, I will be by your side for every need, offering support and professional advice.
